A Psalm of praise. Of David. I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.
Let me give glory to you, O God, my King; and blessing to your name for ever and ever.
（大衛的讚美詩。）我的神我的王啊，我要尊崇你！我要永永遠遠稱頌你的名！
Every day I will bless You, and I will praise Your name forever and ever.
Every day will I give you blessing, praising your name for ever and ever.
我要天天稱頌你，也要永永遠遠讚美你的名！
Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; His greatness is unsearchable.
Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised; his power may never be searched out.
耶和華本為大，該受大讚美；其大無法測度。
One generation will commend Your works to the next, and will proclaim Your mighty acts—
One generation after another will give praise to your great acts, and make clear the operation of your strength.
這代要對那代頌讚你的作為，也要傳揚你的大能。
the glorious splendor of Your majesty. And I will meditate on Your wondrous works.
My thoughts will be of the honour and glory of your rule, and of the wonder of your works.
我要默念你威嚴的尊榮和你奇妙的作為。
They will proclaim the power of Your awesome deeds, and I will declare Your greatness.
Men will be talking of the power and fear of your acts; I will give word of your glory.
人要傳說你可畏之事的能力；我也要傳揚你的大德。
They will extol the fame of Your abundant goodness and sing joyfully of Your righteousness.
Their sayings will be full of the memory of all your mercy, and they will make songs of your righteousness.
他們記念你的大恩就要傳出來，並要歌唱你的公義。
The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion.
The Lord is full of grace and pity; not quickly angry, but great in mercy.
耶和華有恩惠，有憐憫，不輕易發怒，大有慈愛。
The LORD is good to all; His compassion rests on all He has made.
The Lord is good to all men; and his mercies are over all his works.
耶和華善待萬民；他的慈悲覆庇他一切所造的。
All You have made will give You thanks, O LORD, and Your saints will bless You.
All the works of your hands give praise to you, O Lord; and your saints give you blessing.
耶和華啊，你一切所造的都要稱謝你；你的聖民也要稱頌你，
They will tell of the glory of Your kingdom and speak of Your might,
Their words will be of the glory of your kingdom, and their talk of your strength;
傳說你國的榮耀，談論你的大能，
to make known to men Your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of Your kingdom.
So that the sons of men may have knowledge of his acts of power, and of the great glory of his kingdom.
好叫世人知道你大能的作為，並你國度威嚴的榮耀。
Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Your dominion endures through all generations. The LORD is faithful in all His words and kind in all His actions.
Your kingdom is an eternal kingdom, and your rule is through all generations.
你的國是永遠的國！你執掌的權柄存到萬代！
The LORD upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.
The Lord is the support of all who are crushed, and the lifter up of all who are bent down.
凡跌倒的，耶和華將他們扶持；凡被壓下的，將他們扶起。
The eyes of all look to You, and You give them their food in season.
The eyes of all men are waiting for you; and you give them their food in its time.
萬民都舉目仰望你；你隨時給他們食物。
You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
By the opening of your hand, every living thing has its desire in full measure.
你張手，使有生氣的都隨願飽足。
The LORD is righteous in all His ways and kind in all His deeds.
The Lord is upright in all his ways, and kind in all his works.
耶和華在他一切所行的，無不公義；在他一切所做的都有慈愛。
The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.
The Lord is near all those who give honour to his name; even to all who give honour to him with true hearts.
凡求告耶和華的，就是誠心求告他的，耶和華便與他們相近。
He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him; He hears their cry and saves them.
To his worshippers, he will give their desire; their cry comes to his ears, and he gives them salvation.
敬畏他的，他必成就他們的心願，也必聽他們的呼求，拯救他們。
The LORD preserves all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy.
The Lord will keep all his worshippers from danger; but he will send destruction on all sinners.
耶和華保護一切愛他的人，卻要滅絕一切的惡人。
My mouth will declare the praise of the LORD; let every creature bless His holy name forever and ever.
My mouth will give praise to the Lord; let all flesh be blessing his holy name for ever and ever.
我的口要說出讚美耶和華的話；惟願凡有血氣的都永永遠遠稱頌他的聖名。
